function(_mcp_external_create_link_alias ALIAS_NAME)
    if(TARGET "${ALIAS_NAME}")
        return()
    endif()

    foreach(_candidate ${ARGN})
        if(TARGET "${_candidate}")
            string(REPLACE "::" "_" _impl_target "${ALIAS_NAME}")
            add_library(${_impl_target} INTERFACE)
            target_link_libraries(${_impl_target} INTERFACE "${_candidate}")
            add_library(${ALIAS_NAME} ALIAS ${_impl_target})
            return()
        endif()
    endforeach()

    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unable to create ${ALIAS_NAME}; no backing target was found")
endfunction()

function(_mcp_external_silence_msvc_warnings)
    if(NOT MSVC)
        return()
    endif()

    foreach(_target ${ARGN})
        if(TARGET "${_target}")
            target_compile_options("${_target}" PRIVATE /W0)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

if(MCP_USE_BUNDLED_LIBUV)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/libuv/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(LIBUV_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(LIBUV_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(LIBUV_BUILD_BENCH OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(ENABLE_CLANG_TIDY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

        add_subdirectory(libuv)
        _mcp_external_silence_msvc_warnings(uv uv_a)
        _mcp_external_create_link_alias(MCP::libuv libuv::libuv uv_a uv)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled libuv not found. Run git submodule update --init --recursive")
    endif()
endif()

if(MCP_USE_BUNDLED_JANSSON)
    if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/jansson/CMakeLists.txt")
        set(JANSSON_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(JANSSON_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(JANSSON_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(JANSSON_WITHOUT_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(JANSSON_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

        add_subdirectory(jansson)
        _mcp_external_silence_msvc_warnings(jansson)
        _mcp_external_create_link_alias(MCP::jansson jansson::jansson jansson)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled jansson not found. Run git submodule update --init --recursive")
    endif()
endif()

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mbedtls/CMakeLists.txt")
    set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(USE_STATIC_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(USE_SHARED_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(DISABLE_PACKAGE_CONFIG_AND_INSTALL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

    add_subdirectory(mbedtls)
    _mcp_external_silence_msvc_warnings(mbedtls mbedx509 tfpsacrypto)
    _mcp_external_create_link_alias(MCP::mbedtls MbedTLS::mbedtls mbedtls)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled Mbed TLS not found. Run git submodule update --init --recursive")
endif()
